# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Wave 8 Worker 3 Slot 98: Americas Three Indigenous Empires & Nova Elysia Bidirectional Synergy (oe_amr_, 0 vanilla/GUI/DLC overrides). Generated by gen_v130_americas.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Mesoamerica opening: Chinampa agronomy
oe_amr.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_amr.1.title
	desc = oe_amr.1.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_amr_tenochtitlan_chinampas.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.1.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_chinampa_expansion_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
		add_stability = 2
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_chinampa_expansion_mod years = 12 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
}

# 3. Zero-DLC D015/D017 tehotihuacan & cholollan synergy
oe_amr.3 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_amr.3.title
	desc = oe_amr.3.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_amr_teotihuacan_cholula_reform.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.3.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 80
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_amr_holds_both_sacred_pyramids = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_dual_pyramids_synergy_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		}
		else = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_sacred_pyramid_pilgrimage_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
		add_prestige = 8
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.3.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_sacred_pyramid_pilgrimage_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
		add_gold = 120
	}
}

# 15. Core v10.5 Nova Elysia bidirectional choice (sets oe_amr_elysia_pact = 1 or 2)
oe_amr.15 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_amr.15.title
	desc = oe_amr.15.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_amr_haudenosaunee_longhouse.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev15_dispatched value = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.15.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 55
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.0
				any_country = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes oe_eln_is_foederati_path = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.35
				any_country = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes oe_eln_is_limes_path = yes }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_elysia_pact value = 1 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_elysia_foederati_pact_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { any_country = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes num_locations > 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_elysia_notified } } }
			random_country = {
				limit = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes num_locations > 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_elysia_notified } }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.16
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.15.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 45
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.5
				any_country = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes oe_eln_is_limes_path = yes }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_elysia_pact value = 2 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_longhouse_resistance_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		every_country = {
			limit = { oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes NOT = { this = root } }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_longhouse_resistance_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_country = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes num_locations > 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_elysia_notified } } }
			random_country = {
				limit = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes num_locations > 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_elysia_notified } }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.17
			}
		}
	}
}

# 16. Nova Elysia recipient event when Haudenosaunee selects Foederati Compact
oe_amr.16 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_amr.16.title
	desc = oe_amr.16.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_amr_haudenosaunee_longhouse.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_elysia_notified } }
	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_elysia_notified value = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.16.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 75
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.0
				oe_eln_is_foederati_path = yes
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_elysia_longhouse_fur_compact_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = 8
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_amr.16.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.5
				oe_eln_is_limes_path = yes
			}
		}
		add_gold = 120
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_elysia_tribute_primacy_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
}
